title: Checkpoint: triage the incident
prompt:
Events are lines `ts= level= event= requestId= endpoint=

` (already parsed for you as records). Inside Solution, implement `static class Ev` with `long ts; String level, event, requestId, endpoint;` and a constructor `Ev(long, String, String, String, String)`, then: 1. `static List affectedRequests(List events)` — requestIds that have at least one level=ERROR event, in first-appearance order, deduplicated. 2. `static Map byEndpoint(List events)` — count of ERROR events per endpoint. 3. `static List cascadeOf(List events, String requestId)` — the event names for that request in ts order (its full timeline). 4. `static String verdict(List events)` — return "isolated" if exactly one request is affected, "endpoint-outage" if one endpoint accounts for ALL errors and there are 2+ affected requests, else "widespread". 5. `static String refutes(String hypothesis)` — the observation that would kill each leading hypothesis: "endpoint-outage"→"an error on a different endpoint", "isolated"→"a second affected request", "widespread"→"errors stop after deploy".

tests.name: localize, correlate, quantify
tests.hint: Triage as functions over the stream.

tests.name: hypotheses are refutable
tests.hint: Every hypothesis names its own killer.
